follow-up time: From 12-15 weeks of pregnancy until 3 months postpartum
exposure: History of previous adverse pregnancy outcomes (preterm birth or late miscarriage)
cohort: Two cohorts of pregnant women in southwestern Finland: 32 with previous adverse pregnancy outcomes and 30 with normal obstetric histories
finding: The study found no significant difference in subjective stress levels between pregnant women with previous adverse pregnancy outcomes and those with normal obstetric histories.
mod_finding: Women with previous adverse pregnancy outcomes delivered earlier and more often via cesarean section compared to the control group.
